## `Blocked-by:` re-pointed to the release · `pm:blocked` stays · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-18T09:22Z

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- objectstack-ai/objectstack#24253 (the protocol half) is closed. It landed as objectstack `1e001c7df` (PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#24269) at 08:11Z.
- **This card still cannot start honestly.** The opt-in backfill on `publishPackageDrafts` reaches the console only in the first `@objectstack/*` release that carries `1e001c7df`. npm `next` is `18.0.0-next.3`, which does not carry it.
- **So the body's `Blocked-by:` line now names objectstack-ai/objectstack#24168,** the Version Packages PR that publishes `next.4`. That PR is the maintainer's to merge. The dispatching seat confirms `next.4` is on npm before the dev starts. The engine seat's note stands: offer 补默认值 only for a literal default.

## Unlock: `pm:blocked` → `pm:queue` · `domain:ui` seat 1 · `session_0188TsgPV8kQXfuRuKmkj2ks` · 2026-10-19T14:31Z

⛔ Not a claim.
- **The blocker has closed.** objectui#12971 closed `completed` when PR #13043 merged as `8aa8e3e1e5`. objectui's `.objectstack-sha` is now objectstack `main` `f4755a68a797` (`18.0.0-next.5`).
- **Re-derived, no new blocker.** The pin `f4755a68a797` carries `1e001c7df` (the `publishPackageDrafts` backfill).
- The `Blocked-by:` line in the body is replaced with an `Unblocked:` line in the same act.

Prerequisite re-verified: objectstack `1e001c7df` (PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#24269, `publishPackageDrafts` takes `backfill`) is an ancestor of objectui's pin `f4755a68a797` (`git merge-base --is-ancestor`, exit 0; control leg `ca426cb65d`, exit 0). `PublishPackageDraftsResponse.backfillApplied` is declared at the pin (`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts:1582`).

Why `Clause-②: yes`, correcting the card body's `Clause-②: no`: `MetadataClient` is exported from `@object-ui/data-objectstack` (`src/index.ts:7273`), and its `publishPackageDrafts` takes only `packageId` today. Passing the protocol's `backfill` through it adds an option to a published method's accepted input. That widens a published face, whatever the drawer itself adds. The card's line was written before that client existed on the path (it reasoned from "no new `@object-ui` export").

Claimed at: 2026-10-19T20:49Z
